decisions.headline: 《红色沙漠》大型DLC“Charting the Unknown”试玩：海战、潜水与经营系统扩展
decisions.summary: AUTOMATON的试玩报道介绍了《红色沙漠》首个大型DLC：除三名角色的后续故事和连续Boss挑战外，还加入海上委托、航行与潜水，并扩展恋爱结婚、经营和住宅等系统。
decisions.verification: 基于AUTOMATON的完整试玩报道；这是窗口内首次发布的体验与机制梳理，不把10月30日上线的DLC写成当日新发售。
decisions.reason: 窗口内发布的独立试玩包含明确的信息增量。

decisions.headline: Discord测试Auto Clips：按语音反应自动保存游戏高光

decisions.headline: 《侠盗猎车手VI》创下PlayStation史上最大游戏首发纪录
decisions.summary: IGN转述PlayStation披露的数据称，《侠盗猎车手VI》成为PlayStation史上规模最大的游戏首发；玩家在首发最初数日累计游玩6.83亿小时，平均每名玩家约17.4小时，首发还带来单日新接入PS5主机数量纪录。
decisions.verification: 基于IGN对PlayStation官方博客数据的完整转述；仅采用报道明确列出的纪录和数值。
decisions.reason: 可识别的PlayStation官方数据经可信媒体转述，主体、窗口和核心事实明确。
decisions.timeNote: IGN于北京时间11月24日08:14发布，位于固定窗口内。

en.archiveTitle: Daily Brief | GTA VI sets PlayStation’s biggest launch record

entries.headline: Crimson Desert’s Charting the Unknown DLC expands its seas, diving, and businesses
entries.summary: AUTOMATON’s hands-on covers Crimson Desert’s first major DLC, including follow-up stories for three characters, maritime quests, sailing, diving, a boss-rush challenge, romance, marriage, businesses, and housing.
entries.verification: Based on AUTOMATON’s full hands-on. This is a newly published feature, not a claim that the October 30 DLC release happened today.
entries.timeNote: Published by AUTOMATON at 12:34 PM Beijing time on November 23, within the fixed window.

entries.headline: Gothic 1 Remake’s Japanese PS5 download release moves to an unannounced date
entries.summary: Famitsu relays THQ Nordic’s notice that the Japanese PS5 download release has moved from November 24, 2026 to an unannounced date because domestic content adjustments need more time. Existing preorders will be refunded.
entries.verification: Based on Famitsu’s relay of an identifiable THQ Nordic notice; the change is limited to the Japanese PS5 download version.
entries.timeNote: The page entered the fixed packet window, but the evidence does not provide an exact publication time.

entries.headline: Discord tests Auto Clips that save game highlights from voice reactions
entries.summary: Discord’s Auto Clips test can identify reactions such as laughter and screams in voice chat and save gameplay clips. Four games can also trigger clips from in-game events at launch, with access rolling out to Nitro members.
entries.verification: Based on AUTOMATON’s full relay of Discord’s announcement; the feature remains an early-access Nitro test.
entries.timeNote: Published by AUTOMATON at 9:32 AM Beijing time on November 24, within the fixed window.

entries.headline: GTA VI becomes the biggest game launch in PlayStation history
entries.summary: IGN relays PlayStation data saying GTA VI delivered the largest game launch in PlayStation history. Players logged 683 million hours in the first few days, averaging about 17.4 hours each, and PlayStation recorded its largest single-day wave of newly connected PS5 consoles.
entries.verification: Based on IGN’s full relay of PlayStation’s published figures; only the listed records and numbers are used.
entries.timeNote: Published by IGN at 8:14 AM Beijing time on November 24, within the fixed window.

entries.headline: Dokimon Frontier announced as a free monster-collecting roguelike for Steam
entries.summary: Yanako RPGs announced Dokimon Frontier, where players recruit Dokimon, battle through varied environments, defeat stage bosses, and unlock a boss-rush mode. It is planned as a free Steam release in December 2026.
entries.verification: Based on AUTOMATON’s full relay of the developer announcement; no exact December date is inferred.
entries.timeNote: Published by AUTOMATON at 2:06 PM Beijing time on November 23, within the fixed window.

entries.headline: SO-JI -Why Why Japanese- SHINJUKU is formally unveiled with a Steam demo
entries.summary: Developer Gerappa formally unveiled its Shinjuku-set cleaning action game for PC via Steam. The full release remains undated, while a demo became available on November 24.
entries.verification: Based on AUTOMATON’s full relay of the developer announcement; the August store-page appearance is not presented as the formal reveal.
entries.timeNote: Published by AUTOMATON at 9:00 AM Beijing time on November 24, within the fixed window.

entries.headline: Acts of Blood for PC slips to spring 2027
entries.summary: Big Fan Games and Eksil Team moved the PC release of Acts of Blood from December 4, 2026 to spring 2027. PS5 and Xbox Series versions are still due in 2027.
entries.verification: Based on Gematsu’s full relay of the publisher and developer notice; no exact spring date is inferred.
entries.timeNote: Published by Gematsu at 5:00 PM Beijing time on November 23, within the fixed window.

entries.headline: Nioh 3 sets December 17 for Bloody Insurrection and January 28 for its Complete Edition
entries.summary: Koei Tecmo and Team NINJA announced that Bloody Insurrection will launch on December 17, 2026. A Complete Edition will reach PS5, Xbox Series, and PC on January 28, 2027.
entries.verification: Based on Gematsu’s full relay of the Koei Tecmo and Team NINJA announcement; dates, editions, and platforms follow the report.
entries.timeNote: Published by Gematsu at 9:41 AM Beijing time on November 24, within the fixed window.

entries.headline: NVIDIA says Jensen Huang has returned as president and CEO
entries.summary: 4Gamer relays NVIDIA’s announcement that its board unanimously restored founder Jensen Huang as president, CEO, and a director with immediate effect on November 23 in the United States.
entries.verification: Based on 4Gamer’s relay of NVIDIA’s announcement; only the stated roles and immediate effective date are used.
entries.timeNote: Published by 4Gamer at 10:55 PM Beijing time on November 23, within the fixed window.

entries.headline: Darkest Dungeon II’s The Butcher’s Asylum turns arena crowds into finishing moves
entries.summary: 4Gamer’s WePlay Expo 2026 report describes The Butcher’s Asylum as a standalone arena survival mode in which pleasing the crowd builds toward powerful finishing attacks.
entries.verification: Based on 4Gamer’s event-floor report; the mode structure is limited to details explicitly described in the article.
entries.timeNote: Published by 4Gamer at 3:58 PM Beijing time on November 23, within the fixed window.

entries.headline: Wave Race: Blue Storm joins Nintendo GameCube Nintendo Classics
entries.summary: Nintendo has added the 2001 GameCube racer to Nintendo GameCube Nintendo Classics. It is available to Nintendo Switch Online + Expansion Pack members.
entries.verification: Based on AUTOMATON’s full relay of Nintendo’s release information; the platform and membership tier follow the report.
entries.timeNote: Published by AUTOMATON at 9:43 AM Beijing time on November 24, within the fixed window.

entries.headline: GTA VI developers placed the names of late family members on an in-game memorial
entries.summary: AUTOMATON reports that two GTA VI developers confirmed that an in-game memorial bears the names of family members they lost during development, including a mother, a father, and a daughter.
entries.verification: Based on AUTOMATON’s full relay of the two developers’ public posts; no additional memorial names are inferred.
entries.timeNote: Published by AUTOMATON at 5:39 PM Beijing time on November 23, within the fixed window.

entries.headline: Analysts say Call of Duty player counts fell more than 40% after GTA VI’s launch weekend
entries.summary: IGN relays Alinea Analytics’ estimate that player counts for the Call of Duty app dropped by more than 40% following GTA VI’s launch weekend. The figure is third-party analysis, not publisher data.
entries.verification: Based on IGN’s full relay of Alinea Analytics; the percentage remains explicitly attributed to the analytics firm.
entries.timeNote: Published by IGN at 7:37 AM Beijing time on November 24, within the fixed window.

entries.headline: D’Angelo’s estate confirms unreleased song Kamikaze appears in GTA VI
entries.summary: IGN reports that D’Angelo’s estate confirmed Kamikaze, heard in GTA VI, was an unreleased track the artist created for the game in 2024.
entries.verification: Based on IGN’s full report of the estate’s confirmation; only the song title, creation year, and game connection are used.
entries.timeNote: Published by IGN at 3:56 AM Beijing time on November 24, within the fixed window.
